left_items.to_check: answer Q9 (R-26): Q4 (TS-26): after session expiry, must the system extend the session, or ask for login and then add the product?

The add is accepted for the guest: a 2xx, no redirect to login and no 401.; In the new context with the same cookie `GET /api/cart` holds the line for B quantity 1.; An anonymous context with no cookie sees no line for B (the cart is owned by the cookie). What the guest sees before the first add (empty vs login prompt, BN-9, Q4) is not asserted.; The `Set-Cookie` of the guest add (step 1) is persistent: it carries `Max-Age` or `Expires` in the future, not a session-only cookie that is lost when the browser closes (the persistence clause of R-5).

Both second requests are refused (4xx, INSUFFICIENT_STOCK-class error), not a 2xx and not a 5xx.; The line of A still has quantity 3 (not 6, not 5); the line of S still has quantity 1.; Boundary: a third `POST` A quantity 2 (3 + 2 = stock 5) is accepted and the line of A reads 5.

Each request is answered with a 4xx error or the add is capped to a limit that is at most the stock (10): never a 5xx and never a line above stock.; After each request `GET /api/cart` holds either no line for B or one with quantity at most 10.; The application stays up: `GET /api/health` answers 200 and a normal add of quantity 1 for B afterwards is accepted.
The answer is 404 with the error code BOOK_NOT_FOUND.; The cart has no line for that bookId and the user's line count is the same as before the request.

After the UI attempt (step 2): `GET /api/cart` holds no line for O and the badge is unchanged.; The wording check: a message or label naming the out-of-stock state is visible on the page (either reading of Q5 satisfies it). The Then asserts only the presence of the text "out of stock" (case-insensitive) on the page (open question Q5, BN-1).; After the API attempt (step 3): the request is not a 2xx and `GET /api/cart` holds no line for O. The exact 4xx code is informative only; R-2 states only "cannot be added".
After login the cart page shows B with quantity 2.; `GET /api/cart` (signed in again) holds the line of B with quantity 2 and no second line for B.

A visible message states the available number (4).; `GET /api/cart` holds no line for B after the request completed. (Whether only the available quantity could be added instead is open question Q2; this Then asserts the requirement text "nothing is added".)

Valid partitions (P-one, P-ten, P-234, P-contains-zero, P-multi-digit, P-stock-boundary): `GET /api/cart` holds one line for B whose quantity equals the entered value exactly (not truncated, not clamped, 234 is not 23 or 2, 100 is not 1) and subtotal is value x P (P from the catalog record).; P-zero: a visible rejection message; no line for B.; P-negative and P-non-integer: a visible rejection message; no line for B (never rounded or coerced to 1).; P-non-numeric: a visible error message; no line for B.; P-above-stock (301): a visible message stating the available number 300; no line for B.; Every invalid partition (P-zero, P-above-stock, P-negative, P-non-integer, P-non-numeric): the cart read via the API after the click completes holds no line for B.; For every partition the typed value stays whole in the field and the field keeps focus until the click (multi-character value entered whole, cleared and re-entered, pasted).

If Q6 = a (person's answer): G is in the user's cart at quantity 3, equal to the quantity the guest added (the guest item is not lost and the quantity is not coerced to 1); `GET /api/cart` as the signed-in user shows it. Otherwise it follows the owner's answer (before).; If Q6 = a: H has quantity 4 (higher of 2 and 4 wins, not 6); otherwise the owner's rule (before).; If Q6 = a: Z is absent (no stock, dropped) and no line has a quantity above its stock; otherwise the owner's rule (before).
A quantity of 0 is rejected with a clear message and nothing is added
